messages.subject: Re: Information
parts:
The original book is way out of date and even Winston's book is getting old at this point. 

The shortest thing to get the idea is the Rstudio cheatsheet:
http://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/ggplot2-cheatsheet-2.0.pdf

I managed to build the newest book this morning though from github: 

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BxI1qsD5Q0uXWEdtV0twVW1hWHM/view?usp=sharing

Things will likely change from this though. 

Run through the examples of the functions you want to use and you'll get the hang of it.

messages.author: 0e424990a477f3b5
messages.subject: Re: Information
parts: If you are using Rstudio, you can use the ggthemeassist addin. I would recommend familiarizing yourself with the resources listed in the other comments for basic ggplot usage, and then use the ggtheme assist interface to understanding the process of modifying themes (e.g., axis labels, grid lines, colors, etc.). See github/calligross/ggthemeassist for installation and usage.
